valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E. FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS (the year priced at the Nov 2027 target date) times a P/E. Anchor: FY2025 adjusted EPS $5.42; FY2026 guidance raised on 2026-10-29 to $5.66-$5.74 (+4.5% to 6.0%); 9M 2026 adjusted EPS $4.33. FY2027 EPS is my assumption of about +5% on a $5.70 midpoint, from pricing, buybacks (program expanded by $1bn) and ABI income, offset by cigarette volume declines. US listing, USD, no ADR conversion. Targets are price only; dividends separate.

bear.driver: Cigarette volumes decline faster, smoke-free losses widen, EPS growth stalls near +2%, multiple de-rates

base.driver: FY2026 lands mid-guidance, FY2027 EPS grows about 5% on pricing and buybacks

bull.driver: Smoke-free (on!, NJOY return) gains, resilient pricing, EPS growth near 8% and multiple holds

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $6.00 the $78.64 close implies 13.1x; no 12-month-documented targets are weighted, but the sample mean of $74.80 implies 12.5x on base EPS, or EPS $5.75 at 13.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.00 (7.6 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Adjusted diluted EPS growth versus the raised $5.66-$5.74 FY2026 guidance, and domestic cigarette volume decline
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results, expected late January 2027 (date not confirmed)

analyst_notes: Five named calls were found, all after the 2026-10-29 earnings release: Barclays (Sell) raised to $60 from $58, Citi (Hold) to $72, Morgan Stanley (Hold) to $77, UBS (Buy) to $83 and Stifel (Buy) to $82. The spread of $60 to $83 reflects the Barclays bear view versus Buy-rated houses; Stifel and UBS imply about 13.7x to 13.8x on my base EPS. Horizons are undocumented so none are weighted, and older calls were not retrieved.
